clips.note: Panda Pour at D1 (Table II), trial 2 in all four folders (same starting layout, checked on first frames). Same rule for every tile: from just before the arm moves until its policy stops (iter counter freezes / GOAL box removed in the annotated twin) or the recording ends. TL PROXY+ wide_pour/proxyplus/2_raw 0-11.5 s: pitcher tilted with the spout over the cup ~8.5-11.2 s, policy stops 11.2 s (iter 14, progress 0.952); the gripper then releases and the pitcher falls on its side at ~11.6 s (cut). TR PROXY wide_pour/proxy/2_raw 0-11.7 s: pitcher horizontal at the cup ~8-11.4 s, policy stops 11.4 s (iter 15, progress 0.922); the carry-back to the start spot from ~11.8 s is cut. BL SPOT wide_pour/spot/2_raw 0-21.17 s (whole run): pitcher carried and tilted beside the robot base, never brought over the cup; policy still running at iter 29 when the recording ends. BR DP wide_pour/dp/2.mp4 1.95-61.0 s at 4x (640x360 15 fps source): grasps the pitcher ~2-8 s and holds it near its start until the ~60 s time limit, never pours; source has tearing bursts ~24-32 s and ~55-61 s (all paired DP trials tear similarly). Poster in the final hold.

Panda Place at D1, PROXY+, raw (wide_coffee/wide/8_raw) 0-18.73 s, machine rotated relative to D0: mug grasped ~1-3 s, lifted high and carried around ~4-12 s, set on the drip tray under the spout ~13.5-16.7 s; while retracting at ~16.9-17.2 s the gripper bumps the machine and pushes machine and mug toward the camera, mug still under the spout at the end.
